name: expo-mobile
description: Expo / React Native app: EAS QA, simulator and production builds, Maestro QA on simulators, and mobile checks for core commands.

facts.name: MOBILE_DIR
facts.meaning: App directory holding app.json / app.config.* and eas.json, relative to the repo root
facts.ask: Which directory holds the Expo app (the one with eas.json)? Use . for the repo root.

facts.name: EAS_CLI
facts.meaning: How the EAS CLI is run
facts.ask: How should the EAS CLI be run? (default npx eas-cli@latest; use eas if it is installed globally)

facts.name: EAS_ACCOUNT
facts.meaning: Expo account or organization that owns the EAS project
facts.ask: Which Expo account or organization owns the project? (eas project:info shows @<account>/<slug>)

facts.name: EAS_PROJECT_SLUG
facts.ask: What is the EAS project slug? (eas project:info shows @<account>/<slug>)

facts.name: EAS_PROFILE_QA
facts.meaning: eas.json build and submit profile for QA device builds sent to TestFlight / Play internal testing
facts.ask: Which eas.json profile makes QA device builds for TestFlight / Play internal testing? (default preview)

facts.name: EAS_PROFILE_SIM
facts.meaning: eas.json build profile for iOS simulator / Android emulator builds
facts.ask: Which eas.json profile makes simulator / emulator builds? (default preview-simulator)

facts.name: EAS_PROFILE_PROD
facts.meaning: eas.json build and submit profile for store releases
facts.ask: Which eas.json profile makes store release builds? (default production)

facts.name: APP_ID_QA
facts.meaning: Bundle ID / Android package name of the QA app variant
facts.ask: What is the bundle ID / package name of the QA app variant?

facts.name: APP_ID_PROD
facts.meaning: Bundle ID / Android package name of the store app. Automation never targets it
facts.ask: What is the bundle ID / package name of the store app?

facts.name: MAESTRO_DIR
facts.ask: Where do the Maestro flows live, relative to the repo root? (default .maestro)

facts.name: MAESTRO_FLOW_MAP
facts.meaning: Project-owned file mapping changed areas to Maestro flows. Default docs/agent/maestro-flows.md
facts.ask: Where should the Maestro flow map live? (default docs/agent/maestro-flows.md)

facts.name: PROMOTION_BLOCK_LABEL
facts.meaning: Ticket label that stops /build-prod and /release while an open ticket carries it. Default blocks-promotion
facts.ask: Which ticket label should block store builds after a failed Critical-System build QA? (default blocks-promotion)

facts.name: NEEDS_BUILD_QA_LABEL
facts.meaning: Ticket label on a merged mobile change not yet driven on a build. Default needs-qa-on-build
facts.ask: Which ticket label marks a merged mobile change still waiting for build QA? (default needs-qa-on-build)

owner_tasks.task: Authorize the Expo MCP server: run /mcp in Claude Code and sign in with the Expo account
owner_tasks.why: the hosted server uses OAuth, so there is no token to store; it gives read-only build, log and store tools. Optional: Codex and the commands use the EAS CLI

owner_tasks.task: Create eas.json in the app directory (MOBILE_DIR) with the three build profiles named by EAS_PROFILE_QA, EAS_PROFILE_SIM and EAS_PROFILE_PROD, if it doesn't have them yet
Store the store credentials in EAS with the EAS CLI ({{EAS_CLI}} credentials): an App Store Connect API key and a Google Play service-account JSON key
owner_tasks.why: EAS submit reaches TestFlight, App Store Connect and Google Play with them; they never go in the repo

owner_tasks.task: Have an Apple Developer team and a Play Console app record with an internal testing track, and make the first Play upload by hand
owner_tasks.why: Play accepts API submissions only after one manual upload

owner_tasks.task: Create a QA test user in the app's backend and name its login env vars in docs/agent/verify-map.md (Test accounts)
owner_tasks.why: Maestro flows sign in as that user; never a real person's account

owner_tasks.task: On the machine that runs QA, install Xcode with a simulator, the Android SDK with an emulator, and the Maestro CLI

env.name: EXPO_TOKEN
env.purpose: Lets the EAS CLI run non-interactively for agents, Codex and CI without an interactive login
env.how_to_get: expo.dev → account or organization settings → Access tokens; prefer a robot user with only the access the builds need

env.name: MOBILE_QA_USER_EMAIL
env.purpose: Login of the QA test user that Maestro flows sign in with. Record the name in docs/agent/verify-map.md (Test accounts); the project may use its own name instead
env.how_to_get: Create a dedicated QA test user in the app's backend; never a real person's account

env.name: MOBILE_QA_USER_PASSWORD
env.purpose: Password of that QA test user, passed to Maestro by shell expansion and never printed
env.how_to_get: Set when creating the QA test user; keep it only in the local env / secret store
